northStar.name: The Decision Table
northStar.description: A quiet, premium decision room for curadoria imobiliaria de alto padrao in Florianopolis.

navy.usage: Main background, brand atmosphere and institutional surfaces.

navy-deep.usage: Deeper layer, edge darkness and vignette.

paper.usage: Logo on dark, main text and high-contrast light panels.

brass.usage: Fine rules, dots, sequence accents and proof markers.

logoReferences.primaryOnDark: brandbook-toolkit/02-Logos/LOGO PRINCIPAL/SVG/B. LIVING LOGO - BEGE CLARO.svg
logoReferences.primaryOnLight: brandbook-toolkit/02-Logos/LOGO PRINCIPAL/SVG/B. LIVING LOGO - AZUL ESCURO.svg
logoReferences.compactOnDark: brandbook-toolkit/02-Logos/LOGO COMPACTA/SVG/Logo B. LIVING COMPACTA - BEGE CLARO.svg
logoReferences.compactOnLight: brandbook-toolkit/02-Logos/LOGO COMPACTA/SVG/Logo B. LIVING COMPACTA - AZUL ESCURO.svg
logoReferences.generationRule: Generated images and production layouts must use the real SVG logo. Never recreate the B. Living signature as typed text.

display.fontFamily: Bodoni Moda, Bodoni 72, Didot, Bodoni MT, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif
display.purpose: Hero-scale statements such as Antes do imovel, vem a decisao. Officialized from the approved visual reference: high-contrast serif, editorial and architectural.
display.generationRule: Every serif/display statement in generated images, landing previews, covers, posts, headers and validation tests must be uppercase. Mixed case and lowercase are rejected.

body.fontFamily: Montserrat, Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
body.purpose: Clear strategic explanation without commercial pressure. Officialized from the approved visual reference: clean sans with controlled spacing.

label.fontFamily: Montserrat, Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
label.purpose: Short labels, sequence numbers and map captions.

layoutMeta.structure: Asymmetric editorial grid with visible decision logic, generous silence and thin-line structure.

decisionMap.description: Thin-line analytical panel built from straight lines, rectangles, coordinates and dots.
decisionMap.avoid: waves, nautical motifs, decorative patterns, construction-site visuals

sequenceStrip.description: Ordered proof sequence. Rafael and equipe must appear before bairros, imoveis or product.

statementCard.description: Warm paper editorial block for strategic synthesis and manifesto lines.

motionMeta.allowed: Slow editorial reveals if animated later.
motionMeta.avoid: bounce, elastic motion, flashy transitions and layout-shifting animation.
